integrity: Analytical proof and exact-rational reproducibility code are included. Finite enumeration is corroboration, not a proof for all m and p. Independently conducted validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Independent homogeneous undirected bond transmission on K_{2,m}, two perfect passive monitors, uniform seed including monitors. Strict onset concerns existence of some interior transmission probability and not a full placement phase diagram. General SIR epidemic models and heterogeneous networks are not covered.
title: A sharp nine-vertex onset of mixed sentinel placement in two-hub outbreak networks
